children: TOP Financial Group announced relocation of its global headquarters to Houston, Texas to support U.S. market growth and AI initiatives.
announced phased relocation of global headquarters to 4201 Main Street, Suite 200, Houston, Texas 77002.
move aims to position TOP closer to its expanding AI business, strategic partners and U.S. talent pools.
phased transition over coming months to minimize disruption; local regional offices will continue operations.
company says relocation will accelerate business development, streamline regional operations and target North American opportunities.
